newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - STET leads Euro ADRs in NY.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - STET leads Euro ADRs in NY.

text.p: Italian state telecom holding STET led American Depositary Receipts on Tuesday as European stocks stood out in a quiet market, traders said.

"Things are relatively quiet. The European markets are flat across the board after thinking New York would be up," one trader said. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dipped on profit-taking and ahead of economic data.
STET was up 2-3/4 to 41-1/8, following through on Monday's gains after news it would be merged with state-controlled Telecom Italia before privatization, which has been moved back to late 1997.
Telefonica de Espana was up 3/8 to 64-3/4 after analysts predicted its nine-month net profit would rise 22 percent.
French luxury goods maker LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton rose 1-1/4 to 50-1/4 after it reported nine-month sales had risen 2.3 percent.
British Airways Plc was up 1-7/8 to 98 on continued hopes for the carrier's proposed alliance with AMR Corp's American Airlines.
Australia's News Corp Ltd fell 7/8 to 21-5/8 after an 8.1 percent fall in first-quarter net profits, in contrast to analysts' predictions for a strong rise.

British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc rose 1-3/8 to 52-1/8, rebounding from sharp falls in recent weeks. "The stock has just been beaten and beaten and beaten and is starting to bounce back," a trader said.
Latin American shares were mostly quiet, with Argentina's Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires S.A. up 1/4 to 19-3/4 after reporting a gain in first-quarter earnings per share.
Advancers led decliners by a margin of 239 to 200 among an 807-stock index. Volume was 25.7 million shares.
